item.description:
Discovered: Nov 21, 2026 15:49 (UTC) Helena Horton:: A year after starting treatment with daraxonrasib, 76.6% of pancreatic cancer patients were alive; usually 40-45% of patients given chemotherapy alone survive a year.Pancreatic cancer undetectable for one in 12 patients in trial. Hailed as ‘biggest breakthrough in decades ¦ The Guardian <– Go Science go!

With the previously announced trail of the mRNA vaccine against KRAS and a custom mRNA vaccine, more and more progress against pancreatic cancer, yes!

Previously

  • April 19, 2026: ME:: tl;dr-ing if your pancreatic cancer is operable, a custom mRNA vaccine using the tumor cells removed during your operation appears to work in a small 16 person trial AND there is also an off-the-shelf vaccine that targets a protein called KRAS ; Kaitlin Sullivan, Marina Kopf, Anne Thompson:: Pancreatic cancer mRNA vaccine shows lasting results in an early trial
  • August 1, 2020: Please consider donating to my team, Sofia’s Camera Club, for the virtual Cypress Challenge in honour of my mother who died of Pancreatic Cancer in 2013. 100% of your donations go to pancreatic cancer; this is a zero overhead ride

QUOTE

  • Read the whole thing: Pill to treat pancreatic cancer hailed as ‘biggest breakthrough in decades’ ¦ Pancreas cancer ¦ The Guardian

In one in 12 of the patients given the drug, daraxonrasib, during a trial, the cancer became undetectable, and the tumours stopped growing in almost all of the 61 patients. The trial participants had recently been diagnosed with advanced pancreatic cancer that had spread to other parts of the body.

Though doctors have said the pill cannot yet be considered a cure, and they do not know how long it can keep the disease at bay, they have said it is encouraging news because it appears it will offer patients more time, even if it does not cause full remission.

item.title: #HighlyRecommended : Sisa, a fictional movie about the end stages of the Filipino American war 1898-1902 where over 200,000 people died (and Mark Twain was against). Gut wrenching like America is Not the Heart and Filipiñana. This is what art does: it shines the light on humanity's best and worst.
item.description:
• Draft created: Nov 15, 2026 15:13 (UTC).
  • There is a straight line from the 1898 Filipino American war (Sisa) to Marcos’s brutal dictatorship (America is not the heart) to 2026 (Filipiñana). There are in fact many such lines. We just have to keep drawing them :-)
  • The American men are caricatures but I don’t think that’s bad thing if you think about it from the perspectives of the Filipinos after years of war. All you can see is the other side’s atrocities and stereotypes and in reality, it’s much more nuanced than that. I think everybody can agree though that this was a brutal, barbaric, unnecessary war that was the inevitable consequence of Spanish and American colonialism.
  • The Filipino women particularly, Hilda Koronel’s character, are real people with real PTSD from years of war.
  • Not a hidden war but definitely not something discussed in the Filipino diaspora community. See the links in the next section.
  • Wikipedia: Sisa, Hilda Koronel, there is no wiki page or website that will persist long-term for America is Not the Heart (America is Not the Heart on libby, America is Not the Heart on penguin random house) so check out the author, Elaine Castillo

  • Previously

  • September 19, 2026: Filipiñana 2nd viewing: shot in square i.e. 1:1 re-elect Dr. Palanca, colonialism is not over in the Philippines. This movie still highly recommended.
  • September 7, 2026: HIGHLY RECOMMENDED: Filipiñana, the full 2026 movie, is full arthouse at its most thought (or sleep) provoking and very gut wrenching simultaneously. What actually happened? Did the Doctor and all the Ilustrados get their just desserts :-) ?!?!? Probably not because corruption
  • July 20, 2026: The Americans killed thousands (if not tens of thousands or 100,000 or more) Filipinos in this war and Americans have forgotten about it even though it’s not a hidden conspiracy theory. See Karnow’s In our Image for a biased American history of this ; Mmina Maclang Tamayo aka @thoughtspresso:: It doesn’t escape me as someone from a former US colony (and in many ways continue to be under Uncle Sam’s thumb), that they indeed brought a gift horse to our shores. In the late 1890s, under the guise of friendship, the US staged the Battle of Manila to pretend to help fight off the Spanish colonizers. Then they turned around and became our colonizer
  • September 1, 2019: 28 second :-) podcast: America Is Not The Heart - Elaine Castillo - Highly Recommended!
